# runzero_org_api_key (Data Source)

Fetches the API key for the organization associated with the configured org token.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `client_id` (String) The client UUID that owns the key.
- `comment` (String) Comment associated with the key.
- `counter` (Number) Total usage counter for the key.
- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the key was created.
- `created_by` (String) Identifier of who created the key.
- `id` (String) The UUID of the organization API key.
- `inactive` (Boolean) Whether the key is inactive.
- `last_used_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the key was last used.
- `last_used_ip` (String) IP address that last used the key.
- `last_used_ua` (String) User agent that last used the key.
- `organization_id` (String) The organization UUID the key belongs to.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The organization API key token.
- `type` (String) The type of the key.
- `usage_limit` (Number) Daily usage limit for the key.
- `usage_today` (Number) Number of times the key was used today.
